content.title: Where to watch Nuggets vs. Suns NBA game free tonight during NBC and FuboTV dispute
content.text: Where to watch Nuggets vs. Suns NBA game free tonight during NBC and FuboTV dispute Dustin Hockensmith - pennlive.com (TNS) Mar 24, 2026 Mar 24, 2026 Facebook Twitter Email Print Copy article link Nikola Jokic and the Denver Nuggets are off to the desert on Tuesday night for a Western Conference battle with the Phoenix Suns. The game is scheduled to start at 11 p.m. ET (8 p.m. PT) with TV coverage on NBC and streaming on-demand . NBC is part of the NBC Universal family of networks currently blacked out on FuboTV during ongoing contract negotiations. Available streaming alternatives are listed below. How to watch Nuggets vs. Suns on TV and stream without cable: When:Tuesday, March 24 at 11 p.m. ET (8 p.m. PT) Where: Mortgage Matchup Center, Phoenix, Ariz. TV channel:NBC and Peacock Streaming on: DirecTV (free trial) | SlingTV (low intro rate) | Peacock ($10.99+/mo.) Nuggets vs. Suns: The matchup The Nuggets are 5.5-point favorites going into Phoenix, armed with the NBA’s highest-scoring offense (120.8 ppg) and Jokic, a perennial MVP candidate on pace to average a triple-double for a second straight season. Denver sits at 44-28 on the season and owns wins in three of its past four contests, including back-to-back home victories over the Toronto Raptors (121-115) and Portland Trail Blazers (128-112) on Friday and Sunday, respectively. The Nuggets currently lay claim to the No. 4 spot in a tight Western Conference playoff race. See also: More NBA coverage on PennLive The Suns ride into Tuesday’s showdown with Denver having just snapped a five-game losing streak with a 120-98 win over the Raptors on Sunday. That victory was guided by Devin Booker’s 25-point night and a collective team shooting performance where Phoenix knocked down 45% of its attempts (18-of-40) from 3-point range. The Suns now sit seventh in the West and are 3.5 games behind the Houston Rockets for the conference’s sixth and final secured playoff berth. Nuggets vs. Suns: Know your live streams DirecTV (free trial) : DirecTV offers a 5-day free trial and a total of $30 off over the first three full months for the Choice Package, which includes 125-plus channels and access to ESPN Unlimited, a $29.99 standalone value featuring all ESPN channels and ESPN+. SlingTV (low intro rate) : First full month of streaming runs as low as $29.99 with current offer for 50% off Sling’s Orange & Blue Plan. Day passes are also available for 24 hours ($4.99), as well as three-day ($9.99) and seven-day access ($14.99). Peacock ($10.99+/mo.) : Peacock’s library of live sports is growing and features exclusive NFL and college football games, all in addition to NBC Universal movies, television series, and more. ©2026 Advance Local Media LLC.
